decisive_finding.cause: The canonical MCP validator applies generic bounded-text map-key validation to both environment variable names and HTTP field names. BAD KEY, A=B, A:B, X Header, X=Header, and X:Header therefore enter supported manifest authority through both N02 and N04.

corrective_scope: Define distinct adopted ASCII environment-variable and HTTP field-name grammars in the sole canonical plugin-manifest semantic module.
Preserve bounded values, case-insensitive duplicate rejection, CR/LF rejection, MCP server shape, URL, prompt, metadata, package reachability, and legacy-context boundaries.
Add paired N02 inventory and N04 distribution negative controls for whitespace, equals, colon, CR/LF, and case aliases, plus positive controls for supported env and HTTP field names.
Run focused paired and full distribution verification with cargo-nextest at 16 jobs in isolated targets, then freeze a new exact WorkerResult-v1 for independent rereview.
claim_ceiling: N04 remains an unaccepted internal distribution candidate. Canonical MCP semantics, real package/install/discovery/runtime proof, node closure, readiness, release, and completion remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim N04 completion, readiness, release, or goal completion.
